function.name: upload_file
function.description: Upload a file from the local system to the user's Dropbox account.

local_file_path.description: The path of the file on the local system.

cloud_folder_path.description: The cloud folder path in the user's Dropbox account where the file will be uploaded. If not specified, the file will be uploaded to the root folder '/MyDropbox/'.

function.name: download_file
function.description: Download a file from Dropbox to the local system. It could be a file uploaded by the user or a file shared with the user by others.

user_cloud_file_path.description: The cloud file path in the user's Dropbox account. Required for downloading a file uploaded by the user.

shared_file_id.description: The unique identifier of the shared file. Required for downloading a file shared with the user by others.

local_destination_folder.description: The path of the folder on the local system where the file will be downloaded.
local_destination_folder.default: the default download folder of the local system

function.name: list_files_and_folders
function.description: List files and folders in a given folder in the user's Dropbox account.

cloud_folder_path.description: The cloud folder path in the user's Dropbox account. If not specified, the root folder '/MyDropbox/' will be used.

max_results.description: The maximum number of files and folders to return.

function.name: create_folder
function.description: Create a folder in the cloud storage.

folder_name.description: The name of the new folder.

parent_folder_path.description: The cloud folder path in the user's Dropbox account where the new folder will be created. If not specified, the new folder will be created in the root folder '/MyDropbox/'.

function.name: share_item
function.description: Share a file or folder in user's Dropbox account with another user.

item_path.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be shared.

recipient_email.description: The email address of the recipient.

access_level.description: The level of access granted to the recipient; valid values: 'view', 'comment', 'edit'.

function.name: delete_item
function.description: Delete a file or folder from the user's Dropbox account.

item_path.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be deleted.

function.name: search_items
function.description: Search for files and folders by name or metadata in the user's Dropbox account.

max_results.description: The maximum number of files and folders to return.

function.name: get_item_metadata
function.description: Get metadata of a file or folder in the user's Dropbox account.

item_path.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account.

function.name: move_item
function.description: Move a file or folder to a different folder in the user's Dropbox account.

item_path.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be moved.

destination_folder_path.description: The destination folder path in the user's Dropbox account.

function.name: create_link
function.description: Create a shareable link for a file or folder in the cloud storage.

item_path.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be shared.

function.name: disable_link
function.description: Disable the shareable link for a file or folder in the cloud storage.

item_path.description: The cloud file or folder path in the user's Dropbox account to be unshared.
